shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: After the credits: the Hall of the Ring, rebuilt, empty, night. The Heartstone glows in six colours... then, faintly, a seventh. Ilyra, alone, leans in to look.

shots.text:
He was the first to listen.

I taught him how a world goes quiet.
shots.speaker: the_hush
shots.art_note: Two thousand years ago: the vault under burning Vael. The young Keeper, Vael-Orrun, kneels in the dark with his wife's ring in his fist, listening. Grey creeps into his eyes from the edges.

shots.text:
The Regent thought he bargained with a king.

He bargained with me, wearing a king's voice.
shots.speaker: the_hush
shots.art_note: Six years ago: Cassivane at his daughter's grave in the rain. Above him, a thin crack of starless dark opens in the night sky.

shots.text:
I could never open the door from my side.

You opened it from yours.
shots.speaker: the_hush
shots.art_note: The Crack in the Hollow Rift seen from the far side, from the Outer Hollow: wide open where the Concord marched through. The six Wardens' light spills in from the world beyond it.

shots.text:
Your High King was never my enemy. He was my hand.

So were you.
shots.speaker: the_hush
shots.art_note: Ilyra, frozen in front of the Heartstone. Reflected in both her eyes, very small, something with no colour at all.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Deep inside the seventh colour of the Heartstone, something with no colour at all opens, like an eye.

shots.text:
Seven crowns. One door.

Thank you.
shots.speaker: the_hush
shots.art_note: Black. No sound at all for a moment before the voice, and none after. Title card: TO BE CONTINUED.
